title: VuTeX math oracle record
description: One measurement of one corpus formula, produced by one external engine.
A record is written by a script in projects/vutex.ts/examples/oracle/ and is never hand-edited, so every numeric
field can only come from that engine. Absent capability is recorded as JSON null, not as 0,
an empty object, or a placeholder: null means 'this engine does not report this field'.
Consumers (Rust tests, quality gates) must treat null as 'no oracle evidence' and skip the
comparison instead of reading it as a passing value. A record whose whole measurement set is
null must set `source.status` to `blocked` and explain why in `source.status_reason`.

engine.description: External engine that produced the record, e.g. `katex`, `fonttools`, `lualatex`.

version.description: Version reported by the engine itself. null only when the engine is unavailable.

command.description: Reproducible command that regenerates this record.

description: available: the engine ran and the record carries real measurements.
blocked: the engine cannot run in this environment (missing toolchain, no registry),
so the record carries nulls plus a status_reason.
unsupported: the engine ran but rejected this corpus entry, so the record carries the
engine message in status_reason and nulls for the measurement fields.

status_reason.description: Evidence for blocked/unsupported, e.g. the probe output or the engine error message. null when available.

font.description: Font the engine actually measured with. null when the engine reports no font (KaTeX MathML).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the font file, so a fixture silently regenerated against a different font is detectable.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the measured font.

atom.description: One atom of the engine's normalized formula structure.

value.description: Engine-reported atom text, or the element tag for structural atoms.

bbox.description: Ink bounding box in em units, origin at the formula's left baseline.

scriptPosition.description: Placement of one script relative to its base, in em units.

tex.description: Corpus source, repeated here so a record stays readable on its own.

display_mode.description: Whether the engine was asked for display style. Recorded because display style changes structure and metrics.

size.description: Font size the engine laid out at, in CSS pixels. null when the engine has no notion of a layout size.

normalized_atoms.description: Depth-first atom list of the engine's normalized formula structure. null when the engine reports no atom model.

style_cramped.description: Whether the engine reports its style as cramped (TeX's cramped style variant). null when it does not expose style state.

width.description: Advance width in em units. null when the engine reports no metrics.

height.description: Extent above the baseline in em units. null when the engine reports no metrics.

depth.description: Extent below the baseline in em units, positive downward. null when the engine reports no metrics.

axis.description: Axis height of the formula in em units. null when the engine does not report an axis.

ink_bounds.description: Ink extent, distinct from the advance box. null when the engine only reports metrics or nothing.

rule_thickness.description: Fraction / radical / bar rule thickness in em units when the formula contains a rule. null when the engine reports none.

delimiter_size.description: Extent in em units a stretched delimiter grew to, along its stretch direction. null when no delimiter stretched or the engine hides that geometry.

script_positions.description: Per-script placement relative to its base. null when the engine reports no script geometry.

mathml.description: Engine-produced Presentation MathML, verbatim. null for engines that do not emit MathML.
